hints.title: Tian Ji Horse Racing Strategy
hints.text: Match your smallest possible value that beats the opponent. If none can beat them, waste your smallest available element against their largest element.

hints.title: Sorted Element Pairing
hints.text: Sort both arrays while preserving original index associations of the second array.

hints.title: Dual-Ended Opponent Assignment
hints.text: Iterate your sorted elements. If your current smallest beats their smallest remaining element, assign it there. Otherwise, assign it against their largest remaining element.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def advantageCount(self, nums1: List[int], nums2: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        nums1.sort()
        order = sorted(range(len(nums2)), key=lambda i: nums2[i])
        ans = [0] * len(nums1)
        lo, hi = 0, len(nums2) - 1
        for x in nums1:
            if x > nums2[order[lo]]:
                ans[order[lo]] = x
                lo += 1
            else:
                ans[order[hi]] = x
                hi -= 1
        return ans
```

variables: N: length of arrays nums1 and nums2
complexity.notes: Sorting arrays and two-pointer greedy allocation.
